newsitem.title: GERMANY: SGL Carbon falls on U.S. legal battle talk.
newsitem.headline: SGL Carbon falls on U.S. legal battle talk.

text.p: Shares in Germany's SGL Carbon AG fell over 10 percent in late electronic trade on Thursday amid market speculation that an SGL Carbon unit in the U.S. faced a legal battle over alleged price fixing.
Shares in the carbon and graphite maker were down 29.90 marks, or 11.46 percent, at 231.10 marks, while the overall IBIS DAX of German shares was up 34.80 points, or 0.95 percent, at 3,686.39 points.
No-one from the company was available for comment.
Dealers said the speculation surrounded possible charges against the company that it was allegedly involved in price fixing. "But these are just rumours, nothing is confirmed," said one dealer.
SGL Carbon ended bourse trade in Frankfurt earlier on down 30 pfennigs at 260.20 marks, while the DAX index of bourse trade ended up 0.31 percent at 3,673.03 points.
Other traders said that the share was also hit by rumours that one of SGL Carbon's rivals had discovered a carbon replacement.
